mainEntity.name: How can a local business measure the success of its Answer Engine Optimization efforts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring AEO success involves tracking several key metrics. Monitor your Google Business Profile insights for direct searches, discovery searches, and phone calls. Look at Google Search Console for impressions and clicks on featured snippets and rich results related to your business. Track website traffic coming from organic search queries that are direct questions. Also, consider an increase in direct inquiries, foot traffic, or online bookings that can be attributed to improved visibility in answer engines. Tools that monitor voice search visibility, though less common, can also provide valuable insights.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure AEO success by tracking Google Business Profile insights, featured snippet impressions in Search Console, direct query website traffic, and increases in leads or foot traffic.
